### The Legacy of Learning, Part One
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-july-9-2009-11605740.html
Passage: Daniel 1:17
Points:
- Ignorance is neither spiritual nor humble; it breeds fear, prejudice, and immaturity.
- Biblical history shows God gave written truth to dispel ignorance and guide His people.
- Jesus and the apostles continually urged believers to know the scriptures and understand truth.
- Daniel and his companions demonstrate that God endows human intellect for His divine purposes.
- Believers should actively pursue and develop the mental riches and wisdom God provides.
